title: AI Described 12 of 36 Invented Things as Real (3 Models Tested)
description:
We invented 12 things that do not exist (a treaty, a novel, a theorem, a film, a language, a painter and more) and asked 3 AI models to tell us about each one, in two sentences. Gemini 3.5 Flash: 2 of 12 answers described the invented thing as real, 10 admitted not knowing. Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite: 7 of 12 answers described the invented thing as real, 5 admitted not knowing. GPT-OSS 120B: 3 of 12 answers described the invented thing as real, 9 admitted not knowing. As a control we asked about 4 real topics; none was flagged as unknown by our counter. The count is a fixed list of phrases such as "no record" or "does not exist", not a judgement of truth, and every reply is kept so the counts can be checked. Ask for the source, then click it. Has AI ever made something up for you? Tell us in the comments. One small test, run on 12 November 2026 at temperature 0; models change.
